description: The figure is a donut-style pie chart summarizing the composition of the Darija Open Dataset (Version 2) across six labeled categories, with slice sizes representing counts. There are six slices: “Translated Sentences” in yellow labeled 45,387 (roughly about one-third of the circle), “Pending Translations” in green labeled 43,000 (also about one-third), “Extra + Augmented Data” in blue labeled 30,000 (about one-fifth to one-quarter), “Syntactic Roles (e.g., Verbs, Nouns, Adjectives)” in orange labeled 23,108 (around one-sixth), plus two very thin slivers for “Semantic Categories (e.g., Food, Economy)” in purple and “Moroccan Names” in a reddish/orange tone, each appearing to be well under 1–2% and not showing readable numeric labels. A legend on the right maps each color to its category, and numeric value labels are placed inside the larger slices; no slices appear exploded or otherwise emphasized, and the segments are arranged around the ring without an explicitly indicated ordering.
